evidence.quote: Today, I will focus my remarks on the importance of community banks to our financial system and the challenges they face.
public policymakers must avoid adding regulatory burden on the smallest banks, particularly on those that maintain a more traditional business model.
policymakers need to appropriately refine the regulatory and supervisory framework to minimize unnecessary compliance costs for smaller banks and address impediments to bank formations.
